div.span: Input Voucher Lines: Account, Debit, Credit
Reject: Account Not Found in Org

Set Status: POSTED
Assign Voucher No: JV-YYYYMM-XXXX

Ledger Immutability Lock
Posted entries cannot be modified or deleted

Swap Debit and Credit on all lines
Line Debit -> Credit, Line Credit -> Debit

Post Reversal Voucher
Assign JV-YYYYMM-REV-XXXX
Set reversed_entry_id = Original.id
